entity: Erie and Niagara Counties Regional Planning Board
stance_basis: cited multiple times as a demographic and planning data source with no expressed position on the project
summary: The Erie and Niagara Counties Regional Planning Board (ENCRPB) is referenced throughout the document solely as a source of demographic, population, and employment projection data for the Buffalo SMSA and surrounding areas. It provides population projections for the SMSA, City of Buffalo, Amherst, and Tonawanda, as well as estimates of the proportion of women in Buffalo's population, labor force projections, and employment growth forecasts. The entity does not express any stance on the proposed transit project itself.
complaint_summary: ENCRPB is cited as one of several sources providing population projections for the Buffalo SMSA, City of Buffalo, Amherst, and Tonawanda for 1975–1995, with its 1976 figures listed in Table 2-10.
summary_quote: Since according to the Erie and Niagara Counties Regional Planning Board (ENCRPB), the proportion of women in the City of Buffalo is expected to remain about 53 percent in 1980 (Ref. 15) and the percentage of women in the nation's labor force is expected to continue to increase, the preponderance of women transit users can be expected to continue.
